title: Why pipelining makes a processor faster

options.text: The time one instruction takes by itself
The number of instructions finished in a given time
The first instruction, which now ends in 1 cycle

items.stem: A pipeline has 4 stages and each stage takes 1 cycle. How many cycles does it take to finish 100 instructions?
Why does the total time get shorter even though one instruction takes the same time as before? Answer in one sentence.
